sources.excerpt: Equality Equality 3.1 WHY DOES EQUALITY MATTER? Political Theory Equality is a powerful moral and political ideal that has inspired and guided human society for many centuries. It is implicit in all faiths and religions which proclaim all human beings to be the creation of God.
